note: Rewritten from Light 1930, pp. 192—195; original in English; in the soldier table the row "labrum width" appears twice in the OCR (0.36 and 0.37) and both values are reproduced side by side; the entry "Mandible curvature index II .60" at the end of the soldier table disagrees with the 0.16 given in the diagnostic text, and this has not been altered but is marked in the text.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate not described. Soldier large, head capsule about 1.30 mm wide or more and about 1.50 mm long; head broad, oval in dorsal view, head index about 0.9, widest just behind the middle, sides convex, narrowing anteriorly, head constriction index about 0.85; head high, its dorsal outline rounded; mandibles pale except at the apex, short and strongly curved, the outer end folded in almost at a right angle, head-mandible index about 0.62; basal prominence large; mandible curvature index I about 0.43, II about 0.16; tooth at the outer third, slightly projecting but directed backwards because of the curvature of the mandible. Postmentum widened in the anterior half, shallowly constricted near the posterior end, postmentum constriction index about 0.88. Antennae yellow, about as long as the head. Worker large, abdomen leathery in appearance, usually black owing to the intestinal contents; head large, about 1.15 mm wide and 0.90 mm long; outline of head and labrum circular; second mandibular tooth shorter than in A. arizonensis; third tooth of the right mandible prominent, the notch between it and the basal prominence distinct; basal prominence prominent, longer than its distance from the second tooth; antennae long, distinctly longer than the head including the labrum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and antennae pale yellow, base of the mandibles pale yellow becoming pale reddish brown towards the apex; femora white, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow, coxal sclerites and thorax pale rusty brown; abdomen pale yellowish white, dark grey-black owing to the abdominal contents. Head broad, large and heavy, thorax narrow, abdomen broad, swollen, pointed behind. Head very broadly oval in dorsal view, sides more convex than the posterior margin; ventral surface of the head flat behind, turning sharply upwards towards the mandibular articulations; head raised from the lateral and posterior margins into a high domed central area, the anterior quarter sloping down at an angle of about 45°, marked only in the middle by a low, sloping, slightly irregular frontal prominence; red hairs scattered, those on the frontal prominence, especially around the fontanelle, numerous and large. Mandibles broad and flat, strongly curved inward from the middle, tilted slightly upwards from the basal articulation; tooth at the outer third, slightly projecting but directed backwards. Antennae slender, segments III—V especially slender, slightly longer than the head capsule; 15-segmented; segments III—V small, their combined length not notably greater than that of segment II. Labrum wide, slightly constricted near the base, apex truncate or broadly rounded, sparsely hairy, with four nearly equal spines at the apex and three or four hairs on each side, usually in one row and decreasing posteriorly. Postmentum wide, broadly and shallowly constricted in the posterior half. Pronotum as in fig. X of the original. Measurements (mm): head length 1.44—1.55 (n = 2); maximum head width 1.27—1.43; head width between the anterior lateral corners 0.95—0.99; minimum head width 1.12—1.19; mandible length 0.87—0.96 (n = 3); postmentum length 0.75—0.81; maximum postmentum width 0.44—0.47; minimum postmentum width 0.38—0.42; pronotum width 0.78 (n = 1); labrum width 0.36, 0.37 (n = 1 each); head index 0.88—0.92; head constriction index 0.84—0.88; head-mandible index 0.58—0.66; postmentum constriction index 0.86—0.90; inner mandible length 0.79 (n = 1); mandible curvature 0.34 (n = 1); mandible curvature index I 0.43 (n = 1); minimum mandible curvature 0.15 (n = 1); mandible curvature index II 0.60 (n = 1; the index given here in the original disagrees with the 0.16 stated in the text, and is reproduced as printed).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body generally white, with yellow-red spots at the mandibular margins and articulations; abdomen dirty grey-black owing to the contents. Head broad, thorax relatively narrow, abdomen swollen. Head circular in dorsal view. Measurements (mm): head length 0.84—0.95 (mean 0.89); head length to the clypeus 0.81—0.89 (mean 0.83); head width 1.06—1.18 (mean 1.11); distance between the mandibular articulations 0.50—0.64 (mean 0.54); clypeus length 0.28—0.31 (mean 0.29); antennal length 1.59—2.19 (mean 1.77); mandible length 0.42—0.55 (mean 0.51); pronotum length 0.42—0.53 (mean 0.45); pronotum width 0.74—0.81 (mean 0.77); abdomen length 1.89—2.74; abdomen width 1.30—1.77; all the worker measurements above, except head length, are from 25 workers.
